name: @intellectual-frontiers/workbench
description: The workbench: what a human or an agent needs to do their job with a repository, declared as a contract made of contributions from the units that need things, checked by one command and projected for each harness and for a human, so that a task installs only what it runs.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
